text:
alex (pm): Quick sync 7: we need a compact onboarding + sunset contract appendix for catalog entries. Goal: reduce friction for small customers while keeping enterprise guarantees. 72h for comments?

hani (eng): +1. Propose a compact acceptance bundle: perf bench artifact, minimal eval slice, quant profiles, and a lightweight canary recipe.

tess (eng-ml): Add eval gating: no more than 4% drop on our holdout prompts, and automated smoke tests that run on model package upload.

marta (cs): Customers want clarity on pins. Suggest two offerings: Starter pin (30d, console toggle, self-serve) and Partner pin (90d, migration credits, phone support). Also need transparent pin-exit comms.

owen (legal): Two-lane contract is fine. Need emergency-exit clause (security/PII) and a short annex template customers can sign for Partner pins. Avoid fixed rollback timelines in the base TOS.

alex (pm): Draft decision: Starter & Partner lanes. Starter = self-serve, brief TTL, no SLA. Partner = 90d TTL, comms + credits + dedicated canary slot. Deliverables: bench artifact, canary job, migration playbook, comms templates, legal annex.

hani (eng): I'll own canary job + perf artifact. Canary requirements: 48h on reserved pool, error-rate <0.5%, KV eviction logged.

tess (eng-ml): I'll publish the eval harness and a reproducible sample set; include instructions to replay traffic via `replay.sh`.

marta (cs): CS will draft a migration email + credit memo. We'll run a small beta with 3-5 customers to exercise the Partner flow.

owen (legal): I'll produce the Partner annex and emergency-exit wording. Need to confirm DPA append for Private deployments.

deploy-bot: build:roadmap-epic by @alex created, checks passed :white_check_mark:.

alex (pm): Acceptance checklist (locking in 72h if no objections):
- Bench: artifact + perf numbers attached
- Canary: 48h pass on reserved pool, error-rate <0.5%
- Docs: migration playbook + CS comms + partner annex
- Legal: emergency-exit + DPA verified for Private
- Owners assigned: @hani (canary), @tess (eval harness), @marta (cs comms), @owen (legal)

marta (cs): Scheduling beta invites next Tue. Need a short customer-facing FAQ about pins.

hani (eng): Will post the canary job template and a minimal dashboard stub by EOD.

tess (eng-ml): Will open PR with eval harness and sample prompt slices.
owen (legal): Will circulate annex draft for review before EOD tomorrow.

alex (pm): Thanks all. If no major flags I'll merge the roadmap PR and start the beta.
